name: Zenith Soul Symphony

effects: Seven single attacks (3.05 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Dark 3 with Stacking], [Zenith Mode], [Zenith Mode: Kuja (Dark)] and [Damage Cap +10000] to the user

description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (3.05 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Dark 3 with Stacking], [Zenith Mode], [Zenith Mode: Kuja (Dark)] and [Damage Cap +10000] to the user

description.name: Zenith Mode: Kuja (Dark)
description.text: Increases [Dark Infusion] damage bonus by 20%, cast speed x1.10 for BLK, WHT, BLU, SUM or NAT attacks that deal magical damage, Dark abilities trigger 1 additional time, casts Spirit Attack: Kuja (Dark) after using three Dark abilities (max 1), maximum HP +1500, grants [Astra] after taking the next action, removed if the character hasn't [Zenith Mode]

description.name: Darkflare Star+
description.text: Five single attacks (3.80/3.95 each), capped at 9999/19999 after 0-2/3+ uses

description.name: Snatch Blow+
description.text: Seven single attacks (?/? each) after 0-2/3+ uses, causes [Doom: 45] to the user

description.name: Spirit Attack: Kuja (Dark)
description.text: Grants [Damage Cap +10000 2] and [Dark Ability +30% Boost 2] to the user and damages the user for 25% max HP

description.name: Attach Dark 3 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Dark Level by 3 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Dark 3

description.name: Zenith Mode
description.text: Replaces certain Hero Abilities, certain Hero Abilities don't consume uses, after the duration the status only expires after the character takes an action
